t: Here you have Pygmalion, a sculpture by Alan Thornhill, the British sculptor who lived from 1921 to 2020. Thornhill's long association with clay developed from pottery into sculpture. He made small and large sculptures, portrait heads, paintings and drawings. His methods allowed him to dispense with the sculptural armature and improvise as he went, and his portraits challenge ideas of normality through careful observation. Have a good look at the figure in front of you and how it was shaped.
